description: Start a B2B prospect-discovery job. Debits 100 credits and returns a jobId immediately; the job runs asynchronously (~5-25 min). Poll get_discovery_status with the jobId, then call get_discovery_results when it reaches a terminal state.

criteria.description:
Ideal-customer-profile criteria for a discovery job.

Field names match the REST ``parameters`` object exactly (including the
camelCase ``maxResults``) so this serialises straight onto the wire.

acknowledge_low_yield.description: Set true to run this discovery anyway when the saturation pre-check estimates ~0 net-new companies (the default holds a saturated ICP with a 409 and does NOT charge). Steers the warn-and-confirm gate only — not a search criterion.

items.description:
Company-size brackets accepted by the discovery pipeline.

Kept in lock-step with the REST openapi ``company_sizes`` enum
(``[micro, small, medium, large, enterprise]``) — the MCP tool schema is a SEPARATE
client-side artifact and must not drift from the REST spec, or an agent cannot send a
value the REST API accepts (e.g. ``micro``).

company_sizes.description: Size brackets: micro (≤10), small (up to ~50), medium (up to ~200), large (up to ~500), enterprise (500+). Advisory — the engine may relax to adjacent brackets in thin markets.

language.description: Optional market-language hint as an ISO-639-1 code (e.g. 'de', 'cs', 'pl'). Steers the query->ICP expansion so keyword/industry expansion is generated in the market's language rather than inferred solely from `query`. Advisory, not a hard filter — company and person names are never translated, and results are not restricted to a single content language. Omit to let the engine infer the language from `query` itself.

locations.description: Country/region filters, e.g. ['Germany', 'Austria']. Any of 22+ served markets.

maxResults.description: Soft cap on the number of companies to return (server-capped at 200).

query.description: Natural-language description of the target companies to find, e.g. 'Find retail partners for a Ukrainian menswear manufacturer that sell business clothing'.

sub_country_regions.description: ISO-3166-2 sub-country regions (validated server-side against the shared region set).

items.description:
Value-chain roles accepted by the discovery pipeline's ``target_business_models`` filter.

Kept in lock-step with the REST openapi ``target_business_models`` enum
(``[manufacturer, retailer, distributor, service_provider, unknown]``) — the MCP tool
schema is a SEPARATE client-side artifact and must not drift from the REST spec, or an
agent cannot send a value the REST API accepts.

target_business_models.description: Value-chain-role filter: keep only companies classified as one of manufacturer, retailer, distributor, service_provider or unknown. Omit to accept any role (default — no role filtering). The role is what the TARGET company IS, taken from the noun the customer used for the targets in their own language (roasters, farms, makers, producers -> manufacturer), NEVER inferred from the customer's own business or supply chain (a coffee shop asking for roasters wants manufacturer, not distributor). If the request names no target role, or you are unsure, omit it: a wrong role silently drops every genuine match.

website.description: The caller's own website — self-excluded from results.

name: find_prospects
title: Find prospects
